en: A black‑and‑white image of an ornate late‑19th‑century villa or small palace in landscaped gardens, backed by a forested hillside. The building has a tall central tower with steep, decorative roof and weather vane, timber‑framed upper level, balconies, and elaborate roof finials. People stand near the entrance. The overall look is of a grand spa or resort hotel photographed from the garden.
